Human circulatory system
It is a system that transports oxygen and nutrients through the blood to all the
body cells (parts).
Its structure :
- It consists of :
* Heart. * Blood vessels (tubes). * Blood.
- The human circulatory system has three different types of blood vessels which are :
« Arteries. ¢ Veins. * Blood capillaries.
